news.contents: Browns DB Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with Carolina.
news.analysis: Campbell was considered as questionable this week, but was dealing with multiple injuries and will not be available against the Panthers. Noah Igbinoghene and Mekhi Blackmon should see additional playing time with Campbell out.
news.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) officially inactive for Week 3

news.contents: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his eight targets for 22 yards in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.analysis: Flournoy didn't do much damage through the air but he drew an encouraging eight targets in the loss. If he can continue to get that type of work consistently, Flournoy might work his way into the flex conversation in fantasy leagues. For now, he's best left on the bench heading into a Week 4 matchup against a tough Houston Texans defense.
news.title: Ryan Flournoy draws eight targets in Week 3

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver Ryan Flournoy remains worth watching in deeper PPR leagues after drawing a season-high eight targets in Sunday's loss to Baltimore. He caught only two of them for 22 yards, so the production still has not matched the opportunities. Flournoy now has nine receptions for 67 yards on 18 targets through three games while continuing to work behind CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens in the Dallas passing game. That makes him difficult to trust as an immediate starter, but 18...
news.title: Ryan Flournoy's Target Volume Keeps Him Interesting

news.contents: Rams head coach Sean McVay said the team is hopeful Kamren Kinchens will return this week against the Eagles.
news.analysis: Kinchens is working his way back from a hamstring injury.
news.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) hopeful to return in Week 4

news.contents: Steelers DB Jalen Ramsey was spotted in a sling at Monday's practice.
news.analysis: It appears to be a new injury for Ramsey. His status will need to be monitored in practice ahead of Thursday's game against the Browns.
news.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) seen in sling during practice Monday

news.contents: Pittsburgh Steelers veteran cornerback Jalen Ramsey (wrist) suffered a broken right wrist in the Week 3 win over the division-rival Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday, and it happened on the very first series of the game, according to Nick Farabaugh of Penn Live. Ramsey said it "was hurting" throughout the game, but he is still hoping to play this Thursday night against the division-rival Cleveland Browns. "I'm going to give everything to try to (play). I have to be able to protect it. It's a real ...
news.title: Jalen Ramsey Attempting to Play Through a Broken Wrist

news.contents: Jake Elliott was held to one extra point in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.analysis: Elliott did not attempt any field goals on a rough night for the Eagles on offense. The veteran kicker has now made both of his field-goal attempts and added seven extra points through three games this season. He will take on the Rams in Week 4.
news.title: Jake Elliott makes XP in Week 3

news.contents: DeMario Douglas caught 1-of-5 targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.analysis: Douglas had a tough time connecting with QB Drake Maye on Sunday, catching just one of his five targets for a 38-yard gain. He will continue to see a solid amount of targets on a week-to-week basis moving forward but carries very little fantasy upside for the foreseeable future.
news.title: DeMario Douglas catches one pass in loss Sunday
